docs.title: HarnMaster 3.5E for Fantasy Grounds Unity
docs.text:
Welcome to the documentation for the HarnMaster 3.5E ruleset for Fantasy Grounds Unity.

This ruleset implements the HarnMaster 3rd Edition rules for Fantasy Grounds Unity, focusing on gritty, realistic combat mechanics, detailed injury tracking, and an authentic percentile-based skill system.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Detailed Hit Location System: Full implementation of HarnMaster hit location tables with zone aiming (High, Mid, Low) and per-location B/E/P/F armor protection.
  • Automated Combat Resolution Window: Interactive attack-vs-defense matrix lookup, one-click Block/Dodge, multi-hit resolution, hit location overrides, cover mitigation, and automatic injury application.
  • Realistic Injuries & Medical Resolution: Direct tracking of Minor, Serious, and Grievous wounds, bloodloss, shock/kill/amputation prompts, and the GM Medical Resolution Window (including handoff from Physician sub-rolls).
  • Skill-Based Character Management: Seven-tab character sheet with Skill Group icon filtering, percentile skill checks, situational Sub-Rolls (for both PCs and NPCs), Skill Base (SB) calculations, Sunsign affinities, and development tracking.
  • Magic, Religion & Psionics: Shek-Pvar Convocation filter bar, Religion & Piety tracking, and spell/invocation/psionic action automation.
  • Print-Ready Character Dossiers: Export any character to an 8-page print-ready HTML dossier matching the canonical HârnMaster layout, complete with weapon and armor artwork.

docs.title: Documentation Quick Links
docs.text:
• 📖 User Manual — Comprehensive guide on character sheets, making rolls, combat flow, and GM tools.
  • ⚔️ Combat Resolution — Step-by-step guide to using the interactive Combat Resolution Window (CRW), hit location overrides, and damage application.
  • 📋 Status Effects & Conditions — Canonical reference for conditions, shock/trauma checks, bleeder tracking, and FGU effect syntax.

docs.title: Installation & Modules
docs.text:
1. Subscribe to the HarnMaster 3.5E ruleset on the Fantasy Grounds Forge.
  2. Open the Fantasy Grounds Unity launcher and click Check for Updates to download the ruleset and associated packages.
  3. Create a new campaign and choose HarnMaster as the ruleset.

docs.title: Official Modules
docs.text:
The ruleset includes and supports official modules:

  • HarnMaster 3.5E Core Rules (HarnMaster3.5E_Core_Rules.mod): Comprehensive rulebook and reference manual data, including skills, items, weapons, armor, bestiary creatures, and default strike location tables.
  • HarnMaster Magic (HarnMaster3.5E_Magic.mod): Complete Shek-Pvar magic compendium containing all 82 canonical spells across Gray (Neutral) and all six Convocational chantries, with built-in action automation.
  • HarnMaster Tuzyn Calendar (HarnMaster3.5E_Calendar.mod): Official 360-day Harnic calendar with all 12 months, celestial holidays, and moon phases.
  • HarnMaster Assets (HarnMaster3.5E_Assets.mod): High-resolution Harnic tabletop decals and atmospheric assets.

Automatic Activation

All installed HarnMaster modules are automatically activated for the Game Master and configured for player auto-load when a campaign is loaded. No manual setup in the Modules activation window is required.

docs.title: Combat Resolution
docs.text: The Combat Resolution Window (CRW) is the GM's central interactive dialog for resolving HarnMaster attacks. Whenever an attack is rolled, a CRW opens automatically for the Game Master to coordinate attacker/defender outcomes, cover mitigation, multi-hit damage, strike locations, and wound application.

docs.title: Overview & Workflow
docs.text:
flowchart TD
    A[1. Attack Rolled] --> B[CRW Opens for GM]
    B --> C[2. Defender Rolls or Clicks Block / Dodge]
    C --> D[3. Matrix Result & Hits Table Updated]
    D --> E[4. Click Roll Damage if Needed]
    E --> F[5. Review / Override Location, Aspect, Cover, Armor]
    F --> G[6. Click Apply Result]
    G --> H[Injuries, CT Wounds & Trauma Prompts Updated]
  1. Attack Rolled: A PC or NPC rolls an attack (with Aim Zone and Range Bracket). The CRW opens pre-filled with attacker, defender, weapon, and rolled test level.
  2. Defense: The defender rolls normally—or the GM clicks the CRW's one-click Block or Dodge buttons—and the matrix Result updates immediately.
  3. Damage: Players roll weapon damage as usual, or the GM clicks the contextual Roll Damage (xN) button for NPC attackers.
  4. Review & Override: Adjust Defender Cover, strike Location, Face sub-location, Left/Right side, damage Aspect, Impact, or Armor on the fly.
  5. Apply Result: Applies wounds to the defender, updates Combat Tracker status, and triggers required Trauma/Save prompts.

docs.title: 1. Header & Status Bar
docs.text:
• Open Attacker / Defender Sheet Buttons (link icons left & right): Opens the attacker's or defender's character/NPC sheet directly for quick stat or gear checks.
  • Matchup Line: Displays Attacker vs. Defender.
  • Pending (N) / Counterstrike Jump Button: Appears when additional unresolved CRWs are queued or when a linked Counterstrike CRW exists. Click to jump straight to the next pending resolution window (or switch to the linked Counterstrike window).
  • Defender Status Line: Live readout of the defender's current wounds, fatigue, Physical Penalty, and active Combat Tracker conditions.

docs.title: 2. Roll Results Panel
docs.text: Control / Field Type What It Shows or Does Attack Read-only Attacking weapon, spell, or unarmed action name. Attacker Test Cycler rolled degree (Critical Success, Marginal Success, Marginal Failure, Critical Failure); click to override manually. Defense Cycler Defender's reaction (Block, Counterstrike, Dodge, Ignore). Selecting Ignore treats defense as Critical Failure automatically. One-Click Block Button Rolls a Block check using the defender's highest equipped weapon/shield DML (alerts chat if no blocking weapon is equipped). One-Click Dodge Button Rolls a Dodge check using the defender's Dodge skill (or Agility-based fallback). Defender Test Cycler Defender's rolled degree; click to override manually. Defender Cover Cycler Cycles None, Low, High, and Full cover; automatically reflects Modifier Box cover tags and recalculates covered strike-location protection. Result Read-only Color-coded combat matrix outcome (A*N Attacker Strike, M*N Missile Hit, B*N Mutual Strike, D*N Defender Counterstrike, ATA/DTA Tactical Advantage, AF/DF/BF Fumble, AS/DS/BS Stumble, Block, Miss, Wild Shot). Announce to Chat Button Broadcasts the current matchup and matrix outcome to players in chat and updates the label to Announced. Roll Damage (xN) (contextual) Button Appears automatically beside Announce to Chat for NPC attackers when the matrix grants a hit multiplier (A*N, M*N, B*N). Click to roll the NPC's weapon/action damage directly into this CRW.

docs.title: 3. Hits Table (Single & Multi-Hit Resolution)
docs.text:
Supports both single-strike melee/missile hits and multi-hit flurries or spells:

  • + (Add Hit Location) & Edit Buttons (header right): Manually append another strike row or toggle delete mode to remove extra hit rows.
  • Click Any Hit Row: Selects that row as the active target for the Hit Location, Face Sub-Location, and Left/Right Side override grids below.
Column Type What It Shows or Does Location Read-only Struck body location (including Left / Right or Face sub-part when selected). Aspect Cycler Cycles Blunt, Edge, Point, and Fire for that hit; immediately recalculates against location armor. Imp (Total Impact) Editable Rolled impact (automatically incorporates matrix multiplier and creature size difference). Edit directly for manual adjustments. Arm (Armor) Editable Defender's armor protection at that location (including obstacle cover protection when Defender Cover covers that location). Edit to override. Eff (Effective Impact) Read-only Net impact after armor (Imp - Arm). IL (Injury Level) Read-only Computed injury severity (M1, S2–S3, G4–G5, etc.).

docs.title: 4. Hit Location, Face Sub-Location & Side Grids
docs.text:
• Strike Location Buttons: Highlights the rolled strike location in red. Hovering covered locations notes active cover protection. Click any location button to override the selected hit row and recalculate armor and Injury Level immediately.
  • Face Sub-Location Grid: Appears automatically whenever Face is selected, offering clickable buttons for Eye, Cheek, Nose, Mouth, Jaw, and Ear.
  • Lateral Side Selector (Left / Right): Appears automatically whenever a lateral body part (or Eye / Ear) is selected, highlighting the rolled side and letting the GM switch Left vs. Right with one click.

docs.title: 5. NPC Actions Drawer
docs.text: When either combatant is an NPC, the ACTIONS panel at the bottom displays that NPC's Combat Tracker actions so the GM can inspect traits or trigger follow-up rolls directly from the CRW. If both combatants are NPCs, an Attacker / Defender toggle button in the ACTIONS header switches which NPC's actions are displayed.

docs.title: 6. Apply Result, Cancel & Counterstrike Windows
docs.text:
• Apply Result:
  • Writes each calculated injury onto the defender's Injuries list (updating Wounds, UP, and PP across the character sheet and Combat Tracker).
  • Posts the resolved injury summary and triggers required Shock, Stumble, Knockback, Kill Roll, or Amputation prompts/buttons when applicable.
  • Closes the CRW.
  • Cancel: Closes the CRW without applying any wounds or status changes.
  • Counterstrike Handling: Choosing Counterstrike compares both attack rolls on the matrix. When the defender wins a counterstrike (D*N or mutual B*N), the ruleset creates a linked counterstrike CRW with roles reversed; use the header's Counterstrike jump button to switch directly between the two linked windows.

docs.title: Forge description
docs.text: The HârnMaster 3.5E ruleset implements Columbia Games' percentile RPG system for Fantasy Grounds Unity, providing full automation for combat, injuries, skills, and magic.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Combat Resolution: Automated resolution of Attack, Defense (Block, Counterstrike, Dodge, Ignore), and Damage via the interactive Combat Resolution Window.
  • Hit Locations & Armor: 32 body locations with High/Mid/Low aim zones and layered protection values (Blunt, Edge, Point, Fire).
  • Injury & Trauma System: Wounds tracked by location and severity; automatic calculation of Universal Penalty (UP), Physical Penalty (PP), and Shock recovery rolls.
  • Character Management: Automatic computation of Skill Bases (SB), Mastery Levels (ML), and Sunsign modifiers, with integrated skill development tracking.
  • Magic & Psionics: Full support for Shek-Pvar magic (all 6 Convocations plus Gray), clerical invocations, and psionics with 4-tier success resolution (CS, MS, MF, CF).
  • NPC Import: Text parser for official stat blocks with automatic OCR cleanup, skill ordering, and attack action generation.
  • Character Print Export: Generates a print-ready 8-page HTML character dossier (A4/Letter) for tabletop play or offline reference.
  • Combat Tracker: Displays fatigue, strike locations, active injuries, and status widgets at a glance.
  • Optional Rules: GM toggles for knockbacks, stumble rolls, fumbles, amputations, and bloodloss.

docs.title: HarnMaster Status Effects & Conditions Reference
docs.text: This document provides a reference of status effects, conditions, trauma states, and enchantments in the HarnMaster 3.5E ruleset for Fantasy Grounds Unity (FGU).

docs.title: 1. How Effects Work in HarnMaster 3.5E
docs.text:
In the Fantasy Grounds Unity ruleset, effects applied to characters in the Combat Tracker fall into two categories:

  1. Automated Engine Effects: Recognized keywords and conditions that the ruleset programmatically parses and applies to attack rolls, defense rolls, ability/skill checks, tactical modifiers, or trauma recovery sequences.
  2. Informational & Descriptive Labels: Status names or reminder text (such as Bleeding, Burning, or Infected) displayed on tokens and in the Combat Tracker to remind the GM and players of ongoing conditions that require manual tracking or narrative resolution according to tabletop HarnMaster rules.
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    COMBAT TRACKER EFFECT                    │
├──────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┤
│    Automated Engine Tags     │    Informational Labels      │
│  (ATK, DEF, CHECK, Prone,    │   (Bleeding, Burning,        │
│   Invisible, Unconscious)    │    Infected, Diseased)       │
├──────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
│ Applied directly to rolls,   │ Visual widget & GM reminder; │
│ EML calculations & saves.    │ resolved manually per round. │
└──────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────┘

docs.title: 2. Automated Engine Effects & Keywords
docs.text:
Effects Presets Window

You can apply standard conditions and ambient light levels (Moonlight, Starlight, Near Darkness) without typing effect strings manually by dragging presets directly from the Effects sidebar window onto any Combat Tracker entry.

docs.title: A. Core Supported Conditions
docs.text:
These conditions are built into the ruleset engine and have direct mechanical automation or dedicated token status icons:

Condition In-Game Mechanical Automation Token Icon Prone Attacker: suffers disadvantage / penalty on attacks. Target: standing attackers gain tactical advantage; prone defenders suffer penalty on defense. cond_prone Invisible Grants ADVATK (+20 EML tactical advantage) to attacks. Attackers without special awareness suffer tactical disadvantage against the invisible target. cond_invisible Blinded Imposes DISATK (-20 EML penalty) on all attack rolls. cond_blinded Frightened Imposes DISATK on attack rolls and DISCHK on ability/skill checks. cond_frightened Intoxicated Imposes DISATK on attack rolls and DISCHK on ability/skill checks. — Poisoned Imposes DISATK on attack rolls and DISCHK on ability/skill checks. cond_sickened Restrained / Grappled Imposes DISATK on attacks and limits mobility. cond_restrained / cond_grappled Paralyzed / Petrified Actor is frozen and incapable of making physical attacks or actions. cond_paralyzed Stunned Actor cannot initiate offensive actions; defense rolls penalized. cond_stunned Unconscious Helpless state. Automatically drops Prone. Defenses cannot be mounted (uncontested hits). Governs the automated Shock Recovery system. cond_unconscious Incapacitated Transitional trauma state between Unconscious and Shock or full recovery. Automatically rolls shock checks on recovery. cond_paralyzed Shock Critical medical trauma state (Healing Rate H5). Triggers 4-hour recovery cycles. cond_paralyzed Surprised Tactical surprise state. cond_disadvantage Deafened Informational condition tag; acoustic awareness checks penalized. cond_deafened Charmed Informational condition tag; social/allegiance tracking. cond_charmed Cursed Informational condition tag; can be paired with CHECK: -10. cond_sickened Encumbered Informational condition tag; physical skills penalized. cond_encumbered Stable Trauma stabilization state. — Bleeding / Bleed Informational condition tag for bloodloss tracking. cond_bleed Moonlight Light condition: -10 EML penalty in the dark to attacks, defenses, and Eyesight attribute checks (other skill checks left to GM discretion). Nocturnal creatures (like Gargun) exempt. cond_conceal Starlight Light condition: -20 EML penalty in the dark to attacks, defenses, and Eyesight attribute checks (other skill checks left to GM discretion). Nocturnal creatures exempt. cond_conceal Near Darkness Light condition: -30 EML penalty (some faint light, not pitch black) to attacks, defenses, and Eyesight attribute checks (other skill checks left to GM discretion). Nocturnal creatures exempt. cond_conceal

docs.title: B. Numerical Modifier Keywords
docs.text:
Fantasy Grounds evaluates effect strings containing numerical components using the format TAG: [number]. The following modifier tags are active in the HarnMaster 3.5E ruleset:

Keyword Syntax Affected Rolls Description Example ATK: [n] Melee & Ranged Attacks Adds or subtracts flat EML from attack rolls. ATK: 20 or ATK: -10 @ATK: [n] Incoming Attacks Modifies incoming attacks against the targeted actor. @ATK: -20 DEF: [n] Defense Rolls Adds or subtracts flat EML from Dodge, Block, or Counterstrike rolls. DEF: -20 or DEF: 10 CHECK: [n] Ability & Skill Checks Adds or subtracts flat EML from general skill and attribute checks. CHECK: -15 INIT: [n] Initiative Modifies the calculated initiative roll for the actor. INIT: -10 or INIT: 20 [ATTR]: [n] Specific Attributes Flat modifier to specific HarnMaster attributes (STR, DEX, AGL, END, WIL, AUR, INT, EYE, HRG, SML, VOI, CML, MOR, STA). STR: 2; END: 1

Flat Integer Modifiers Only

Numerical modifiers in FGU effect strings must always be flat integers (e.g. CHECK: -20). Formula expressions, percentages, or division operators like CHECK: /2 or SPEED: /2 are not supported by the FGU effect parser.

docs.title: C. Tactical & Conditional Effect Tags
docs.text: Keyword Tag Mechanical Behavior in Ruleset ADVATK / @ADVATK Forces Tactical Advantage (+20 EML) on attacks. DISATK / @DISATK Forces Tactical Disadvantage (-20 EML) on attacks. GRANTADVATK Any attacker targeting this actor gains Tactical Advantage (+20 EML). GRANTDISATK Any attacker targeting this actor suffers Tactical Disadvantage (-20 EML). ADVCHK / DISCHK Grants advantage or disadvantage on skill and ability checks. ADVINIT / DISINIT Grants advantage or disadvantage on initiative rolls. COVER / SCOVER / FULLCOVER Applies standard cover modifiers to defense and ranged targeting. SIZE: <1ft to SIZE: 16-32ft Ranged size modifier tags (from -20 to +20 EML) when targeting creatures of non-human scale.

docs.title: 3. Trauma & Recovery System Automation
docs.text:
HarnMaster 3.5E features automated state progression for trauma checks (Shock Rolls) triggered by injury or recovery:

                      ┌──────────────────────┐
                      │   Suffers Injury     │
                      └──────────┬───────────┘
                                 │
                                 ▼
                      ┌──────────────────────┐
                      │     Shock Roll       │
                      │  (1d6 per UP vs END) │
                      └──────────┬───────────┘
                                 │
                     ┌───────────┴───────────┐
                     ▼                       ▼
                 [Pass]                   [Fail]
             No change in              Collapses:
             consciousness           ┌───────────────────────────────┐
                                     │ • Effect: "Unconscious"       │
                                     │ • Effect: "Prone"             │
                                     │ • Defenses: Uncontested       │
                                     └───────────────┬───────────────┘
                                                     │
                                                     │ 1-minute / 10-minute
                                                     │ Recovery Roll
                                                     ▼
                                     ┌───────────────────────────────┐
                                     │     Recovery Shock Roll       │
                                     └───────────────┬───────────────┘
                                                     │
                                     ┌───────────────┴───────────────┐
                                     ▼                               ▼
                                  [Pass]                          [Fail]
                         Transition to Recovery:            Remains Unconscious
                         ┌─────────────────────────┐
                         │ • Removes Unconscious   │
                         │ • Effect: Incapacitated │
                         │ • Immediate Shock Check │
                         └───────────┬─────────────┘
                                     │
                     ┌───────────────┴───────────────┐
                     ▼                               ▼
                  [Pass]                          [Fail]
          Full Recovery from Shock:         Degrades into Deep Shock:
          ┌───────────────────────┐         ┌─────────────────────────┐
          │ Removes Incapacitated │         │ • Removes Incapacitated │
          │ Returns to action     │         │ • Effect: "Shock"       │
          └───────────────────────┘         │ • Healing Rate H5 state │
                                            └─────────────────────────┘
  • Unconscious: Applied automatically when failing a Shock roll. The character collapses (Prone; Unconscious), drops weapons, and cannot make defense rolls (opponents make uncontested strikes).
  • Incapacitated: Applied automatically when passing an Unconscious recovery roll. Triggers an immediate follow-up Shock check. If passed, the character recovers completely; if failed, the character degrades into medical Shock.
  • Shock: Represents the critical physiological shock state (HarnMaster Healing Rate H5). Requires medical intervention and daily 4-hour recovery rolls (HR × END).

docs.title: 4. Physical Combat & Tabletop Conditions Reference
docs.text:
The table below outlines common tabletop conditions, noting their actual rule mechanics and the corresponding valid FGU effect syntax:

Condition HarnMaster Rule Mechanics FGU Implementation & Effect String Automation Level Prone (Knockdown) Character on ground. -20 EML to attacks and defenses. Standing foes gain +20 EML. Costs movement to stand. Prone; ATK: -20; DEF: -20 Automated (via Prone condition & flat modifiers) Stumble Failed Agility test from knockback or leg injury. Character drops Prone. Prone; ATK: -20; DEF: -20 Automated (apply Prone) Fumble Dropped weapon or lost guard from critical failure or arm injury. Narrative resolution; disarm/drop weapon Manual Bleeder (Bloodloss) Grievous wound generates 1 Bloodloss Point (BP) per minute. Exsanguination if BPs exceed Endurance. Bleeding (shows cond_bleed icon) Informational (tracked via Injuries tab / manual BPs) Crippled Limb G4/G5 extremity injury. Limb unusable until healed to M1. CHECK: -20 (applied to affected limb skills) Semi-Automated (flat modifier) Blinded (Complete) Both eyes destroyed or blinded by flash/magic. -40 EML attack, -20 EML defense. Blinded; ATK: -40; DEF: -20 Automated Deafened Loss of hearing from trauma or blast. Acoustic awareness fails automatically. Deafened; CHECK: -30 Semi-Automated (shows icon; check penalty applies) Fatigue (FL) Exertion or heavy armor. Each level adds +1 to Universal Penalty (UP). Native FT box on character sheet / CT Automated (native engine counter) Encumbered Load exceeds capacity. Movement halved; physical skills penalized. Encumbered; CHECK: -10 Semi-Automated Infected Wound fails 5-day healing roll. Evaluated daily on Infection Table. Infected Informational (GM tracks daily HR progression) Diseased Pathogen exposure. Causes fever, chills, or weakness (-10 to -30 penalty). Diseased; CHECK: -20 Semi-Automated Poisoned Venom exposure (irritant, paralytic, or lethal). Poisoned; CHECK: -20; ATK: -20 Automated (applies disadvantage/penalties) Burning (On Fire) Character on fire. Takes 1d6 Fire damage each round until extinguished. Burning Informational (GM rolls 1d6 F damage on turn) Frightened / Morale Broken Failed morale check. Must flee or surrender; cannot initiate attacks. Frightened; ATK: -20; DEF: -10 Automated (forces disadvantage & attack penalties) Tactical Advantage (TA) Won combat exchange or tactical position. +20 EML on next strike. ATK: 20 Automated Tactical Disadvantage Outmaneuvered or poor footing. -20 EML on next action. ATK: -20; DEF: -20 Automated

docs.title: 5. Supernatural Powers & Spells Effect Configuration
docs.text: When configuring spell action sets, psionic powers, or divine miracles in Fantasy Grounds Unity, use these standard effect strings:

docs.title: Arcane Magic (Shek-Pvar)
docs.text:
• Globe of Setath (Savorya / Mind):
  • Critical/Marginal Failure on Save: Stunned; DEF: -20
  • Marginal Success on Save: CHECK: -10; DEF: -10
  • Invisibility (Lyahvi / Air & Light):
  • Invisible (automatically applies tactical advantage to attacker and disadvantage to foes)
  • Flesh of Stone / Earth Armour (Fyvria / Earth):
  • Armor protection bonuses are configured directly on the hit location or item record.
  • Haste / Quickening (Peleahn / Fire):
  • INIT: 20; ATK: 10
  • Web / Entanglement (Fyvria / Earth):
  • Restrained; ATK: -20; DEF: -20
  • Slumber / Deep Sleep (Savorya / Mind):
  • Unconscious; Prone

docs.title: Divine Invocations & Miracles
docs.text:
• Blessing / Divine Favor (Common):
  • Blessed; CHECK: 10; ATK: 10
  • Curse / Malison (Common):
  • Cursed; CHECK: -10; ATK: -10
  • Holy Radiance / Awe (Larani / Honor & War):
  • Awestruck; ATK: -20
  • Battle Fury (Sarajin / Battle & Frost):
  • Berserk; ATK: 20 (GM manually ignores pain/shock checks)
  • Sanctuary / Pacification (Peoni / Mercy & Healing):
  • Sanctuary; DEF: 20
  • Silence (Save-K'nor / Order & Riddles):
  • Silenced (narrative/informational; prevents verbal casting)

docs.title: 6. Master FGU Effect Syntax Cheat Sheet
docs.text:
Use this quick-reference table when building character sheets, NPC actions, and item effects in Fantasy Grounds Unity:

Desired Mechanical Result Valid FGU Effect String Notes Attack Bonus ATK: 20 Adds +20 EML to attack rolls Attack Penalty ATK: -20 Subtracts 20 EML from attack rolls Defense Bonus DEF: 20 Adds +20 EML to Dodge/Block/Counterstrike Defense Penalty DEF: -20 Subtracts 20 EML from Dodge/Block/Counterstrike General Skill / Check Bonus CHECK: 10 Adds +10 EML to all attribute and skill checks General Skill / Check Penalty CHECK: -15 Subtracts 15 EML from all attribute and skill checks Initiative Modifier INIT: 10 or INIT: -10 Adjusts initiative roll Tactical Advantage on Attacks ADVATK Forces tactical advantage on attack rolls Tactical Disadvantage on Attacks DISATK Forces tactical disadvantage on attack rolls Attacker Advantage Against Target GRANTADVATK Anyone attacking this target gains tactical advantage Full Cover FULLCOVER Applies full cover modifiers against ranged attacks Target Scale (Tiny to Huge) SIZE: <1ft to SIZE: 16-32ft Modifies ranged attack EML based on target size Knockdown / Prone Prone; ATK: -20; DEF: -20 Standard prone combat state Complete Blindness Blinded; ATK: -40; DEF: -20 Standard blindness combat state Unconscious Collapse Unconscious; Prone Marks character helpless; triggers shock recovery Shock Recovery State Incapacitated Triggers shock check upon recovery Critical Trauma State Shock; CHECK: -20 Critical medical state (H5) Bloodloss Marker Bleeding Displays bleed token icon; tracked manually Fire Hazard Marker Burning Reminder tag; GM rolls 1d6 F damage per round

Reference manual compiled for the HarnMaster 3.5E ruleset on Fantasy Grounds Unity.

docs.title: HarnMaster 3.5E for Fantasy Grounds — User Manual
Introduction
docs.text: This manual explains how to use the HarnMaster 3.5E interface inside Fantasy Grounds Unity — what each button, icon, cycler, and field displays or does, and what multi-step windows or automated actions those controls trigger. Keep your HarnMaster rulebook handy for tabletop rules; rule mechanics are mentioned here only where they clarify what the software automates.

docs.title: Header Bar (FATIGUE & PEN. & ROLLS)
docs.text:
Every tab shares the same character sheet header:

Control / Field Type What It Shows or Does Portrait & Name Editable / Display Displays the character portrait (double-click to change) and editable character name. FATIGUE Editable number Tracks active fatigue levels (0 minimum). Changes feed immediately into Universal Penalty (UP) and the Combat Tracker FT column. PEN. & ROLLS (UP / PP) Read-only display Shows current Universal Penalty (UP) and Physical Penalty (PP) (hover for tooltip). Rolls Toggle (die icon) Button Shows or hides the Quick Rolls Strip directly below the header.

Automatic Penalty Application

The ruleset applies UP and PP automatically to attribute, skill, attack, defense, and shock/stumble/fumble rolls. Do not subtract them manually in the Modifier Box.

docs.title: Quick Rolls Strip (Die Icon Beside UP / PP)
docs.text:
• How to Trigger: Click the die icon beside the PEN. & ROLLS readout in the character header.
  • What Opens: Expands a compact quick-roll strip directly beneath the header containing roll buttons for Dodge, Shock, Stumble, and Fumble. Every button supports clicking to roll immediately or dragging to chat / a hotbar slot.
  • Conditional Trauma Row: When severe combat trauma triggers a pending Kill Roll or Amputation check, a crimson second row automatically appears in this strip with dedicated Kill Roll and Amputation buttons.

docs.title: Character Sheet Tabs
docs.text: Tab Contents Main Attributes, Shek-Pvar overview, Religion & Piety summary, and Physical Appearance summary Skills Skill Group icon filter bar, compact skill list with Sub-Roll and Roll buttons, name search, and Detailed Skills window Powers Collapsible Religion panel, Shek-Pvar Convocation filter bar, and Powers list with action automation Inventory Carried items, currencies, and Encumbrance load/penalty calculator Combat Equipped/carried Armor list with coverage details, Mode toggle, and Strike Locations armor table popup Actions Active Injuries list (with Detailed Injuries & Heal rolls) and Weapons list with Attack/Defend/Damage/Ammo controls Notes Birth & Family, Physical/Medical & Mental Traits, Clerical Order, Fighting Order, Background & Holdings, and free-text Notes

docs.title: Main Tab & Background Details
docs.text: The Main tab serves as the character's at-a-glance overview. Most summary blocks here are read-only; click any section's Details button (grid icon at the top-right of the section banner) to open the unified BACKGROUND editor window.

docs.title: Attributes
docs.text:
• Compact View: Click the ATTRIBUTES banner to collapse or expand the grid. Each row displays the attribute name, a Roll die button (supports click or drag), and the read-only Total score. Hovering or viewing detailed stats shows qualitative ratings where applicable.
  • Attributes Editor (Details button): Opens the ATTRIBUTES popup listing every attribute with:
Column Type What It Shows or Does Name Read-only Full attribute name. Base Editable Raw starting attribute score. Mod. Editable Flat adjustment (species, traits, magic, etc.). Total Read-only Computed sum (Base + Mod.) used on rolls.

docs.title: Shek-Pvar, Religion & Physical Appearance Summaries
docs.text: Section Control / Field Type What It Shows or Does SHEK-PVAR Primary Conv., Rank, Convocation Icon Read-only Shows the character's arcane convocation, rank, and emblem; click Details to edit. RELIGION Deity, Deity Icon, Main Deity tag Read-only Lists each configured deity and highlights Main Deity when multiple deities exist. RELIGION Piety Editable number Adjust current piety inline without leaving the Main tab. PHYSICAL APPEARANCE Height (in), Frame, Weight (lbs), Size, Eye Color, Hair Color, Comeliness, Voice, Complexion Read-only Compact physical summary; Size is derived automatically from height/weight, and Comeliness / Voice show descriptive labels. Click Details to edit.

docs.title: Background Details Window (Any Details Button on Main or Notes)
docs.text:
Clicking the Details icon on SHEK-PVAR, RELIGION, PHYSICAL APPEARANCE, BIRTH & FAMILY, CLERICAL ORDER, FIGHTING ORDER, or BACKGROUND & HOLDINGS opens the single-column BACKGROUND editor:

  • Religion Section: Click + on the RELIGION header to add a deity row, type with autofill support, set Piety, toggle the Primary Deity checkbox beside the name, or click the delete button to remove an entry. Entering a deity in Cleric of (under Clerical Order) automatically adds/highlights that deity on the Powers tab.
  • Autofill Fields: Many fields (Primary Convocation, Rank, Frame, Eye/Hair Color, Complexion, Species, Gender, Culture, Social Class, and Deity) offer autofill suggestions as you type.
  • Recalculate Weight Button (inside Weight field): Clicking this icon computes the character's optimum weight from the current Height and Frame.
  • Birthdate Helper Button (inside Birthdate field):
  • How to Trigger: Click the details icon on the right side of the Birthdate field.
  • What Opens: Opens the BIRTHDATE helper dialog with editable Day (1–30), Month (1–12), and Year (TR) inputs and read-only previews.
  • On Update: Automatically formats the Harnic birthdate and calculates Derived Sunsign & Cusp, which in turn applies Sunsign bonuses to matching skills on the Skills tab.

docs.title: Skills Tab & Skill Sub-Rolls
docs.text: The Skills tab provides category filtering, standard percentile rolls, situational sub-roll pickers, and full skill editing.

docs.title: SKILL GROUPS Filter Bar
docs.text:
At the top of the tab, SKILL GROUPS displays monochrome etched category icons for Physical, Comm. (Communication), Language, Religion, Combat, Craft/Lore, and Convoc. (Shek-Pvar Wheel):

  • Click any icon to filter the SKILLS list to that group (the active icon highlights).
  • Click the active icon again to clear the filter and show All Skills.

docs.title: Compact Skills List
docs.text: Column / Control Type What It Shows or Does Name Read-only Skill name (with speciality appended if set). Hover for a tooltip listing any available sub-rolls. SB Read-only Skill Base computed from the linked attributes and Sunsign bonus. Sub-Roll (light die left of standard die) Button Opens the SUB-ROLLS picker for skills that have specialized rolls. Skills without sub-rolls show blank space so columns stay aligned. Roll (dark die right of Sub-Roll) Button Makes a standard percentile roll against the skill's effective ML (click or drag to chat/hotbar). ML Read-only Current Mastery Level rolled against. Filter Box (bottom) Editable search Type part of a skill name to filter the list live.

docs.title: Sub-Roll Picker (SUB-ROLLS) (Secondary Die Icon / NPC Shift+Roll)
docs.text:
• How to Trigger: Click the Sub-Roll light die icon on a PC skill row, or hold Shift while double-clicking or dragging an eligible skill on an NPC sheet.
  • What Opens: Opens the SUB-ROLLS window titled with the skill name and listing each situational roll (for example: Physician — Diagnose, Treat Injury, Veterinary Medicine (-10); Rhetoric; Foraging; Herblore; Lockcraft Complexity 1–9; Weatherlore; and Craft Assess checks). Hover any row or roll button for its description.
  • Interactive Choice: Click a row's Roll button (or drag it to chat / a hotbar slot) to roll with that scenario's modifier applied.
  • On Resolution:
  • Posts the scenario-tagged EML, d100 roll, Degree of Success (CS / MS / MF / CF), and automated table outcome (such as foraging yields) to chat.
  • For Physician → Diagnose and Treat Injury, automatically hands the rolled result to the Game Master and opens the Medical Resolution Window (MRW) pre-filled with the check result.

docs.title: Detailed Skills Window (Details Button on SKILLS Header)
docs.text:
Click Details on the SKILLS header to open the expanded skill editor:

Column Type What It Shows or Does Name Editable Base skill name. Speciality Editable Optional specialization (e.g., Broadsword, Kaldoric). Skill Group Editable / Autofill Category used by the Skill Groups filter bar. Attributes Editable Linked attributes used to calculate SB (up to three). Sunsigns Editable Sunsign affinities granting bonus ranks when matching the character's birthdate. OML Editable Opening Mastery Level multiplier/formula or fixed base. SB Read-only Computed Skill Base. Dev. Editable Development ranks gained through play. ML Read-only Computed Mastery Level (OML + Dev). Development Roll (dice icon) Button Rolls a Skill Development check (if enabled in GM Options, warns when weapon skill limits are reached).

docs.title: Powers Tab — Magic, Invocations & Psionics
docs.text: The Powers tab manages Shek-Pvar spells, clerical rituals/invocations, and psionic talents. Drag spells or powers directly from library modules onto the tab to add them.

docs.title: Collapsible Top Panels
docs.text:
• RELIGION Panel: Appears automatically once Cleric of is set in Background Details; click the RELIGION banner to expand or collapse. Shows the deity emblem, editable Deity (autofill) and Piety counter, read-only linked Ritual ML, and a Roll die button to test the matching Ritual skill directly.
  • SHEK-PVAR Filter Bar: Click the SHEK-PVAR banner to expand or collapse. Shows Neutral plus all six Convocation medallions ordered around the character's Primary Convocation (shown larger). Hover any medallion to see its name, wheel relationship, and OML; click a medallion to filter POWERS to that convocation, and click it again to show all.

docs.title: Powers List & Action Automation
docs.text:
Click the POWERS banner to collapse/expand the list, or click Details (top-right of POWERS) to open the full Detailed Powers & Power Group editor.

Control Type What It Shows or Does Delete Button Two-step delete when sheet is unlocked. Link (spell icon) Button Opens the underlying power/spell reference record. Cast / Use (star/hand icon) Button Quick-casts or activates the power; hover for a summary tooltip. ML Read-only Linked Convocation, Ritual, or Psionic Talent Mastery Level. Name Editable Power or spell name. Expand Details (magnifying glass) Toggle Shows or hides the embedded modular action rows (Cast, Attack, Save, Damage, Heal, Effect) and mini quick-action icons.

docs.title: Cast & Modular Action Flow
docs.text:
• How to Trigger: Click Cast on an expanded power row (or use the mini Cast icon on a collapsed row). If the power has configurable options, click the ? (Choices) button first to choose variants, and use the Target button or Combat Tracker targeting to pick targets.
  • What It Reads: Evaluates the linked Convocation, Ritual, or Psionic ML, active UP, and any group modifiers.
  • On Resolution:
  • Posts the cast result (CS / MS / MF / CF) to chat and automatically increments Fatigue when the power carries a fatigue cost.
  • Synchronizes the rolled Degree of Success (DoS) across sibling action rows (Damage, Save, Effect) so follow-up clicks automatically use the CS/MS/MF/CF outcome.
  • Attack actions feed directly into the Combat Resolution Window (CRW); Effect buttons apply HarnMaster conditions or modifiers directly onto targeted Combat Tracker tokens.

docs.title: Power Group Detail Window
docs.text: Accessible via Details (next to POWERS) and group detail buttons: configure Group Name, Group Type (Spell / Ritual / Psionic), linked Skill, Piety (current / max), Attack Stat/Modifier, Uses per period, and Prepared count.

docs.title: Inventory Tab
docs.text: Manages carried equipment, monetary wealth, and automated encumbrance.

docs.title: Carried Items (INVENTORY)
docs.text:
• Click + on the INVENTORY header (when unlocked) or drag items from the Items sidebar onto the list to add gear.
  • Each row provides: Delete, item Link, # Count (editable), Name (editable), Location (container/stowage slot; editable), Weight (editable per-unit/item weight), and Carried State icon:
Carried State Behavior Not Carried Stored away; excluded from load calculations and Combat/Actions lists. Carried Stowed in pack/location; counts toward Carried and Total load. Equipped Worn or ready; feeds armor protection into Combat → ARMOR / STRIKE LOCATIONS and keeps weapons ready on Actions.

docs.title: Currencies & Encumbrance
docs.text:
• CURRENCIES: Click + to add currency rows, edit Amount (supports dropping numeric values onto the field to add) and Name, or delete rows when unlocked.
  • ENCUMBRANCE: Displays read-only Carried, Equipped, and Total weight, a Penalty Base cycler (Equipped vs. Carried), and read-only Penalty. The calculated Encumbrance Penalty feeds automatically into Physical Penalty (PP) on the sheet header.

docs.title: Combat Tab — Armor & Strike Locations
docs.text: The Combat tab shows your armor inventory, hit-location coverage, and overall body protection. Drag armor records directly onto this tab to add them.

docs.title: Mode Bar & Armor List
docs.text:
• Mode Cycler (bottom bar): Cycles between Standard (displays all carried/equipped armor and WT) and Combat (compact view hiding weight and focusing on worn protection).
  • ARMOR Header & List: Click Details (grid icon at top-right of ARMOR) to open the STRIKE LOCATIONS window. Each armor row shows:
Control / Column Type What It Shows or Does Armor Artwork Clickable image Shows the item picture (or material fallback icon). Click to open the full artwork preview if assigned, or the item sheet otherwise. Link Button Opens the item record. Carried Toggle (below link) Button Cycles Not Carried / Carried / Equipped directly from the armor list. NAME / COVERAGE Read-only Item name plus wrapped list of covered body locations (hover for full tooltip). WT (Standard mode only) Read-only Item weight. B / E / P / F Read-only Armor Blunt, Edge, Point, and Fire protection values.

docs.title: Strike Locations Window (Details Button on ARMOR Header)
docs.text:
Opens the STRIKE LOCATIONS helper window showing:

  1. Encumbrance Summary: Displays Carried, Equipped, Total, Penalty Base cycler, and Penalty at the top for quick tuning while adjusting armor.
  2. STRIKE LOCATIONS Table: Two-column body map displaying the total combined B / E / P / F protection at every body location (Skull, Face, Neck, Thorax, Shoulder, Upper Arm, Elbow, Forearm, Hand, Abdomen, Groin, Hip, Thigh, Knee, Calf, Foot), updating live whenever armor is equipped, unequipped, or modified.

docs.title: Actions Tab — Injuries & Weapons
docs.text: The Actions tab combines active wound tracking with weapon combat controls.

docs.title: Injuries Sub-Panel
docs.text:
Click the INJURIES banner to collapse/expand, click + to add an injury manually, or click Details to open the expanded clinical table.

  • Compact Row: Shows Delete (unlocked), Location (wound description & struck location), Aspect (Blunt, Edge, Point, Fire, Frost), and IL (Injury Level 1–5). Active Injury Levels automatically sum into UP and the Combat Tracker Wounds column.
  • Detailed Injuries Window (Details button): Lists Location, Aspect, IL, HR (Healing Rate), Date, Notes, delete control, and a Heal die button per row:
  • Clicking Heal (or dragging it to chat) performs a single-wound healing progression roll for that injury.

docs.title: Weapons List (WEAPONS)
docs.text: Click the WEAPONS banner to collapse/expand. The bottom bar provides the Mode cycler (Standard vs. Combat) and the Add Weapon sword button (adds a blank weapon entry; you can also drag weapons from Items onto the list).

docs.title: Weapon Header Row
docs.text:
Control Type What It Shows or Does Delete Button Removes the weapon (when unlocked). Weapon Artwork Clickable image Displays weapon artwork or category fallback icon. Click to open the full artwork preview or weapon sheet. Link Button Opens the underlying Inventory item record. Carried (Standard mode) Button Syncs Carried / Equipped state with Inventory. Weapon Type Cycler Switches displayed attack rows between Melee, Ranged, and Thrown. Handling Cycler Cycles hand mode / weapon handling state. Name Editable Weapon name (when unlocked). Roll Strike Location on Target (crosshair icon) Button Complex trigger: Rolls d100 against the currently targeted combatant's hit location table in the Combat Tracker (or falls back to the default humanoid table if no target is set) and posts the struck location to chat. Details (grid icon) Button Opens the Weapon Editor popup.

Right-click a weapon entry for its radial menu: Add Attack Entry → Add Melee / Add Ranged / Add Throwing.

docs.title: Weapon Action Row Controls
docs.text: Control / Field Type What It Shows or Does Aim Zone Cycler Cycles High, Mid, and Low; applies aim modifier and informs CRW location rolls. Attack (sword icon) & AML Button + Read-only Click or drag to roll Attack against current effective AML (opens CRW for the GM). Defend (shield icon) & DML Button + Read-only Click or drag to roll Block/Parry defense against current effective DML. Range Bracket & Range (Ranged/Thrown) Cycler + Read-only Cycles Short, Medium, Long, and Extreme range brackets, updating effective AML and displayed metre distance. Damage Aspect Cycler Cycles Blunt, Edge, and Point for the next damage roll. Damage (fist icon) & B/E/P Button + Read-only Click or drag to roll weapon damage for the active aspect (updates an open CRW if targeted). Reorder (bars icon) Drag handle Drag to reorder attack entries within the weapon. Ammo (Ranged/Thrown) Number + Pip tracker Set max ammo count and click pips to mark/restore spent ammunition.

docs.title: Weapon Editor (Details Button on Weapon Row)
docs.text: Displays a larger clickable Weapon Artwork thumbnail, editable Weapon name, WQ / Current weapon quality counters, and weapon-level Properties, followed by three dedicated lists (MELEE, RANGED, THROWN). Each section has its own + add button, Edit/Delete toggle, and per-row fields: Note, Skill (with weapon-skill autofill), A (Attack mod), D (Defense mod), HM (Hand Mode), B / E / P (Blunt / Edge / Point impact), Range S/M/L/E (Ranged/Thrown), and per-action Properties (merged with weapon properties on rolls).

docs.title: Notes Tab
docs.text:
Organizes character biography, orders, traits, and free-form notes:

  • Read-Only Biographical Summaries: BIRTH & FAMILY, CLERICAL ORDER, FIGHTING ORDER, and BACKGROUND & HOLDINGS mirror the character's biographical record cleanly; click any section's Details button to edit fields in the BACKGROUND window.
  • PHYSICAL / MEDICAL TRAITS & MENTAL TRAITS: Dedicated interactive trait lists. Drag entries directly from the Traits sidebar library onto either list, click a trait link to open its description, or unlock the sheet to add, edit, or delete entries.
  • NOTES: Scroll-free multi-line free-text field at the bottom of the tab.

docs.title: Exporting & Printing Character Profiles
docs.text:
The ruleset includes an automated print generator that exports an 8-page print-ready HTML character dossier matching the canonical HârnMaster 3.5E sheet layout:

  1. Open the character sheet (or right-click the character in the Characters sidebar list) and select Export Character.
  2. Choose a destination file and save. Alongside the XML export, FGU writes a companion .html dossier covering:
  3. Page 1: Character Profile, Portrait (supports in-browser drag-and-drop photo replacement), and Attributes.
  4. Page 2: Skills, Skill Bases, Sunsign affinities, Development, and Mastery Levels.
  5. Page 3: Combat Armor Coverage (32-location B/E/P/F map), Weapons (with weapon & armor artwork), Aim Zones, and Range Brackets.
  6. Page 4: Trauma, Injuries, Healing Rates, UP/PP, and Shock data.
  7. Page 5: Inventory, Containers, Coinage, and Encumbrance.
  8. Page 6: Psionics & Esoteric Talents.
  9. Page 7: Shek-Pvar Magic & Clerical Rituals.
  10. Page 8: Background, Orders, and Family History.
  11. Open the .html file in any browser and press Ctrl+P to print or save as PDF.

docs.title: Making Rolls & The Modifier Box
docs.text:
All percentile tests compare d100 against effective Mastery Level (ML), outputting Critical Success (CS), Marginal Success (MS), Marginal Failure (MF), or Critical Failure (CF) directly to chat.

  • Click any Roll die icon to roll immediately, or drag any die icon onto the chat window, the dice tower, or a hotbar slot for quick access.

docs.title: The Modifier Box
docs.text:
The floating Modifier Box above chat modifies your next roll:

Control Function Numeric Box & +2 / -2 / +5 / -5 Adds a flat bonus or penalty to the next roll's EML (or damage total). Multipliers (x2 – x7) Overrides the default x5 Skill Base multiplier on attribute/skill checks (e.g., x2 Very Hard through x7 Trivial), or multiplies damage dice on weapon damage rolls. Low Cover / High Cover / Full Cover Applies incoming ranged/cover EML modifiers (-10 / -20) and tells the Combat Resolution Window to test covered strikes against obstacle protection. Prone Applies the Prone tactical modifier on the next attack/defense check.

docs.title: Combat Flow Overview
docs.text:
Combat resolves through Attack → Defense → Damage → Trauma Prompts:

  1. Attack: Target an opponent on the map or Combat Tracker, choose your Aim Zone (High, Mid, Low) and Range Bracket (if ranged/thrown), and click Attack. The ruleset applies UP, Aim Zone, Range, Prone, Cover, and Creature Size differences automatically and opens the Combat Resolution Window (CRW) for the GM.
  2. Defense: The defender rolls Block, Dodge, or Counterstrike (or selects Ignore). The CRW compares both rolls on the matrix immediately.
  3. Damage & Injury: If a hit multiplier applies, roll Damage (weapon or CRW prompt); the CRW applies armor/cover mitigation and generates the resulting wound upon Apply Result.
  4. Automatic Trauma Prompts: Applying an injury updates Wounds and UP and posts required Shock checks—or triggers Kill Roll / Amputation buttons on the sheet and Combat Tracker when severe trauma occurs.

👉 See Combat Resolution for the complete interactive walkthrough of the Combat Resolution Window.

docs.title: The Combat Tracker
docs.text:
The Combat Tracker displays HârnMaster-specific columns and expandable drawers per combatant:

Control / Section Visibility Function Wounds, FT (Fatigue), HP Header row Wounds totals active Injury Levels (and accepts dropped damage rolls); FT edits Fatigue inline. Reopen Combat Resolution (crossed swords) GM Reopens the Combat Resolution Window for an active/pending attack against that combatant. Active (sword toggle) Host / Player Shows Initiative, Speed, and clickable NPC Traits, Actions, and Spells. Defense (fist toggle) GM (NPCs) Quick attribute scores plus Fumble, Stumble, Shock, Kill Roll, and Amputation roll buttons; strike location list (accepts damage/injury drops); and inline Injuries list (+ add and edit toggle). Effects (person/aura toggle) Host / Player Active status conditions, numerical modifiers, and durations (accepts drags from the Effects presets window).

Initiative Radial Menu: Right-click a Combat Tracker entry (or menu button) and choose Set Initiative → Set All / NPC / PC Initiatives.

docs.title: Medical Resolution Window (MRW)
docs.text:
The Medical Resolution Window coordinates Diagnosis, Treatment, Healing Cycles, Infection checks, Shock Watch recovery, Tourniquet/Cauterize stabilization, Surgical Amputation, and Bloodloss tracking.

  • How to Trigger:
  • Opens automatically for the GM whenever a Player Character or NPC rolls Physician → Diagnose or Treat Injury from the SUB-ROLLS picker (PC Sub-Roll icon or NPC Shift+Double-Click / Shift+Drag).
  • Can also be opened from medical/healing workflow actions.
  • Window Controls & Flow:
  • Patient & Wound Selectors: Choose the Patient from the dropdown (campaign PCs and Combat Tracker actors), or choose "Other" for an ad-hoc NPC not stored in the database. When a sheet-backed patient is chosen, pick the specific injury in the Wound dropdown. (With Other, no DB wound selection is required.)
  • Physician & EML Override: Review or adjust Physician name and EML Override (0 = automatic lookup from rolled skill or sheet).
  • Wound Summary: Read-only snapshot displaying Wound, Severity, Aspect, IL, HR, Diagnosis Bonus, Infected, and Bleeder.
  • Roll & Re-Roll: Shows calculated Target (TL) (editable if GM override is needed), Roll, and Result degree (CS / MS / MF / CF). Click Re-Roll to roll again inside the window.
  • Proposed Outcome: Pre-fills editable results (Proposed Outcome text, New HR, New IL, Is Diagnosed, Diagnosis Bonus, Attr. Reduction *, Infected, Bleeder).
  • Confirm / Cancel: Click Confirm to apply all approved outcome fields to the patient's wound record and broadcast to chat (if Other is selected, Confirm finishes cleanly without requiring a database node), or click Cancel to close without saving.

docs.title: Effects Presets Window
docs.text:
Open the Effects sidebar button (running figure icon) to drag and drop ready-made tags onto Combat Tracker entries without memorizing syntax:

  • LIGHTS: Token vision light presets (Torch, Lantern, Candle, etc.).
  • LIGHT CONDITIONS: Ambient darkness conditions (Moonlight, Starlight, Near Darkness).
  • CONDITIONS: Standard automated and informational conditions.

👉 See Status Effects & Conditions for automated vs. informational condition behavior and effect syntax.

docs.title: NPCs
docs.text: Manage NPCs from the NPCs sidebar across four tabs: Main, Locations, Notes, and Pictures.

docs.title: Main Tab
docs.text:
• Summary Banner: Size and Type (collapse/expand).
  • Attributes Grid: Compact editable attribute grid; click any Roll die button to roll an attribute check.
  • Skills Field: Comma-separated multi-roll text field (e.g., Sword 65, Physician 58).
  • Double-Click / Drag: Rolls a standard percentile check for the highlighted skill.
  • Shift+Double-Click / Shift+Drag: Opens the SUB-ROLLS picker when the hovered skill has specialized sub-rolls (hover any skill for a tooltip showing its available sub-rolls).
  • Senses: Free-text sense notes.
  • ACTIONS: Click + to add narrative/parsed actions, click Edit to delete or reorder rows, or drag weapon items directly into the list to generate combat lines automatically.

docs.title: Locations Tab
docs.text:
• Worn Armor & Details: Shows equipped armor summary; click Details to open the NPC armor/location detail window.
  • Header Action Row:
  • Roll Strike Location (die icon) & Show/Hide Roll (eye icon): Rolls an NPC strike location and toggles whether results appear publicly in chat or remain GM-hidden.
  • Natural Armor (B / E / P / F): Editable base natural armor values.
  • Refresh Armor Values (circular arrows): Recomputes per-location B/E/P/F from natural armor plus worn armor (skips rows marked with Manual Override).
  • Add default Strike Locations (table icon): Populates standard humanoid d100 hit locations; prompts for confirmation before overwriting existing rows.
  • Strike Location Rows: Editable range (From–To), L/R lateral checkbox, Strike Locations name, B / E / P / F values, plus (when unlocked) Loc shorthand ID and Man (Manual Override) checkbox to protect custom row armor during refreshes.

docs.title: Sidebar Libraries & GM Options
docs.text:
• Traits Library: Create or browse Traits (formerly Feats) and drag them directly onto character Physical / Medical Traits or Mental Traits lists.
  • Items Grouped View: Includes a Vendor column alongside Weight, Weapon Quality, Attack/Defense/Hand Mode, Damage, and Armor B/E/P/F columns.
  • Encounters: Build encounter groups and push all NPCs directly to the Combat Tracker.

docs.title: GM Options (Settings → Options → HarnMaster Rules)
docs.text: Option Effect Combat: Knockbacks Enables automatic knockback checks on qualifying high-impact hits. Combat: Limb injuries Tracks impaired / unusable limb conditions on severe extremity wounds. Combat: Amputations Enables pending Amputation checks on grievous extremity edge/blunt wounds. Combat: Bleeders Enables active arterial/venous bleeder flags and bloodloss tracking. Skills: Weapon SBx5 experience cap Displays a warning when developing weapon skills at or above SB × 5. Skills: Weapon Initiative+10 cap Displays a warning when developing weapon skills at or above Initiative ML + 10.
